mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.street_area_id, sa.name AS street_area_name, p.name, p.poi_type, p.store_id, p.longitude, p.latitude, p.description, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, s.name AS store_name, s.business_status AS store_business_status, CASE WHEN s.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(sf.url, '/static/default-cover.svg') END AS store_cover_image_url FROM poi p JOIN street_area sa ON p.street_area_id = sa.id LEFT JOIN store s ON p.store_id = s.id LEFT JOIN stored_file sf ON s.cover_image_file_id = sf.id WHERE p.id=#{id}
